applicability.scope: Diagnose the TorchAir Python ACL graph path from configuration and FX compilation through capture-key selection, fallback, input staging, replay and output lifetime.
applicability.prerequisites: Eager correctness established first; configuration must match the installed backend, with authorization and workload-specific tolerances for any NPU comparison.
applicability.input_contract: Installed hardware/runtime versions, actual compile backend/options, shape/dtype/stride and alias/mutation contract, retained outputs, capture/replay/fallback observations and workload mix.
applicability.produced_artifact: A branch-specific diagnosis and bounded configuration or lifetime proposal with correctness, cold/warm cost, resource and concurrency checks still required on the actual stack.
applicability.failure_modes: Shape equality or clone_input=False does not prove capture reuse or zero-copy; capture limits can trigger persistent fallback and later replay can overwrite retained outputs.

recommendations: Use the installed CompilerConfig/backend surface and a fresh compiled instance for option changes; do not mix registered-backend snippets with callable-backend configuration.
Observe capture, recapture, replay and persistent fallback separately, including changed addresses and revisiting old keys after a capture-limit event.
Preserve earlier results before another replay and check views/input-output aliases; keep cold capture, input/output copying, optional compiler passes and service timing separate.
